ValidationRule.description: Mandate Group Agent Name and Group Agent Email if value of Relationship is "Group Travel Manager of'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Relationship__c , 'Group Travel Manager Of'), OR(ISBLANK(Group_Agent_Name__c), ISBLANK( Group_Agent_Email__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the value for Group Agent Name and Group Agent Email
